_comment: Drukhari army rules + faction-specific citations (10e). Power From Pain in the current codex is a pool-and-spend mechanic: tokens accrue into an army-wide pool, and are SPENT to Empower a unit so its per-datasheet 'Pain ability' takes effect until the end of the phase. There is NO passive Lethal Hits / Feel No Pain 6+ on holding a token — that was an older index version of the rule. Per-datasheet Pain abilities are not catalogued in SwegHammer yet, so the spend half of the rule produces no in-sim effect; the accrual machinery is preserved for future per-datasheet hooks.

simulator.power_from_pain.quoted_text: All DRUKHARI units have a Pain ability, tagged with the word 'Pain'. Pain abilities only apply to a unit while it is Empowered. If your Army Faction is DRUKHARI, you can Empower units from your army with Pain abilities by spending Pain tokens. If your Army Faction is DRUKHARI, you gain Pain tokens as follows: 1 Pain token at the start of your Command phase. 1 Pain token each time an enemy unit is destroyed. 1 Pain token each time an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test. Each time you gain a Pain token, keep it to one side - this is your Pain token pool. Each time you spend a Pain token, reduce your Pain token pool by the same amount. Each Pain ability will state when you can spend Pain tokens to Empower that unit. When you do, until the end of the phase, that unit is Empowered and all Pain abilities it has take effect. While an Attached unit is Empowered, the Pain abilities of all Leader and Bodyguard units in that unit take effect - you do not need to spend additional Pain tokens to activate each of those Pain abilities.
simulator.power_from_pain.trigger: (accrual half, modelled) start of own Command phase; Battle._run_round awards 1 Pain Token to each Drukhari unit Below Starting Strength. The wider accrual conditions (token per enemy unit destroyed; token per enemy unit failing Battle-shock test) and the army-wide pool semantics are NOT modelled — the legacy per-unit cap-of-1 trigger is left in place because no downstream consumer reads the count yet and the additional accruals would be dead state. (spend half, NOT modelled) per-datasheet Pain abilities specify when their tokens may be spent to Empower the unit; SwegHammer has not catalogued any per-datasheet Pain abilities, so no spend ever fires.
simulator.power_from_pain.effect: (accrual half, modelled) the unit's `pain_tokens` field is set to 1. (spend half, NOT modelled) no Empowered state is tracked and no Pain-ability buffs fire — Unit.attack and Unit.receive_damage do not read `pain_tokens` for any combat effect. The earlier implementation that granted passive Lethal Hits + FNP 6+ while pain_tokens > 0 was a fabrication that contradicted the current Wahapedia text (DRK-PAIN-TOKENS, 2026-05-27); it has been removed and now produces no in-sim effect at all. Future work: catalogue per-datasheet Pain abilities (Wyches, Incubi, Kabalites etc.), then wire spend at the per-attack / per-receive_damage call sites against the army's pool with the Empowered-until-end-of-phase scope.

simulator.skysplinter_rain_of_cruelty.quoted_text: Each time a DRUKHARI unit from your army disembarks from a TRANSPORT, until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability and melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LANCE] ability.
simulator.skysplinter_rain_of_cruelty.trigger: a DRUKHARI unit disembarks from a TRANSPORT (voluntary disembark in own Movement phase OR forced disembark when the transport is destroyed) AND the army's detachment is Skysplinter Assault
simulator.skysplinter_rain_of_cruelty.effect: until the next round-start the disembarked unit's `transient_lance_this_turn` and `transient_ignores_cover_this_turn` flags are True. The LANCE flag composes via OR with `profile.lance` at the lance eligibility gate in Unit.attack (still gated on `is_charging` because LANCE itself only fires when this attack is made on the turn the bearer's unit declared a charge). The IGNORES COVER flag composes via OR with `profile.ignores_cover` at the ranged ignore_cover gate so the target's Benefits of Cover save bonus and the in_heavy_cover -1 to hit are bypassed for the disembark turn. Melee mode already ignores cover unconditionally so the IGNORES COVER half is a no-op on the melee branch. Flags cleared at the next round-start by `simulator._clear_transient_stratagem_flags`, matching the 'until the end of the turn' wording. Applies to both voluntary disembark (own Movement phase) and forced disembark (destroyed transport) — the codex wording does not exclude the destroyed-transport disembark from the rule.
